messages:
alex: Heads-up — the v2.3-int4 rollout hit a small quality dip at 1% traffic. MRR down 2.4% vs baseline at minute ~12 then recovered by minute ~40. Thinking about changing probationary window + auto-fallback sensitivity.

sana: Can you paste the numbers and the current config?

alex: Current config: 10m probation, rollback if MRR drop >3% sustained 5m or hallucination rate +1.5% absolute. Snapshot:
```
period: 1% traffic
baseline_mrr: 0.412
v2.3_mrr: 0.402
delta: -0.024 (2.4%)
p95_latency_baseline: 112ms
p95_latency_v2.3: 118ms
halluc_rate_baseline: 0.9%
halluc_rate_v2.3: 1.1%
``` 

jiwoo: The delta seems borderline, recovers by 40m which implies cold-start / cache warming. Longer probation to 30m could allow KV cache and prefix patterns to stabilize. Also consider tiered detection: require delta for two consecutive 5m buckets before trigger.

tonY: Agree on warming, but longer probation increases blast radius if it actually degrades. Maybe keep 10m hard quick-fallback threshold for >6% drop, else 30m for softer 3% drift.

alex: Proposal: change probation_window to 30m, add fast-fail rule: if delta <= -6% within first 5m -> immediate rollback. Also increase sigma threshold from 2 to 3 for auto-fallback on noisy slices. Pseudoconfig:
```
probation_window: 30m
fast_fail_window: 5m
fast_fail_delta_pct: -6.0
auto_fallback_sigma: 3
bucket_size: 5m
slice_enforcement: sample-weighted
``` 

sana: LGTM, add a guard for hallucination absolute delta > 0.5% immediate rollback.

alex: Will add that. Also we'll flag the traffic slices with high longdoc ratio — they are the outliers.

rollout-bot: [incident] smoke-eval: v2.3-int4 at 1% — metric: mrr_delta -2.4% (p=0.07), halluc_delta +0.2%, p95_lat +6ms. No auto-rollback triggered.

jiwoo: Can we run a 1h shadow with the 30m probation on 5% traffic before wide promote?

alex: Scheduling 5% shadow tomorrow 02:00 UTC, will attach eval dashboard and keep channel updated. :thumbsup:

tonY: :thumbsup:
